verse.verse_5: The sun and the moon to a reckoning.
verse.verse_6: The stars and the trees prostrate themselves.
verse.verse_7: He raised the heaven on high and set the scale.
verse.verse_9: Give just weight and do not skimp the scales.
verse.verse_10: He set down the earth for the creation.
verse.verse_11: Therein are fruits and palm trees with sheaths,
verse.verse_12: the grain in the blade; and aromatic herbs.
verse.verse_13: Which favors of your Lord will you both (humans and jinn) belie?
verse.verse_14: He created the human from clay, like earthenware
verse.verse_15: and He created the jinn from smokeless fire.
verse.verse_16: Which favors of your Lord will you both belie?
verse.verse_17: The Lord of the Two Easts, the Lord of the Two Wests.
verse.verse_18: Which favors of your Lord will you both belie?
verse.verse_19: He has let forth the two seas, they meet together,
verse.verse_20: and between them is a barrier which they do not overpass.
verse.verse_21: Which favors of your Lord will you both belie?
verse.verse_22: Pearls and corals come from both.
verse.verse_23: Which favors of your Lord will you both belie?
verse.verse_24: Also, His are the ships that run, raised up like mountains upon the sea.
verse.verse_25: Which favors of your Lord will you both belie?
verse.verse_26: All that live on it will perish.
verse.verse_27: Yet the Face of your Lord will abide forever, Majestic and Splendid.
verse.verse_28: Which favors of your Lord will you both belie?
verse.verse_29: Whosoever is in the heaven and earth ask Him. Every day He is upon an affair (He reveals according to His Eternal determination).
verse.verse_30: Which favors of your Lord will you both belie?
verse.verse_31: We shall surely aim, O both burdened.
verse.verse_32: Which favors of your Lord will you both belie?
verse.verse_33: Tribe of jinn and of human, if you are able to penetrate the provinces of heaven and earth, pass through them! But you shall not pass through except with a power!
verse.verse_34: Which favors of your Lord will you both belie?
verse.verse_35: Flames of fire and molten copper shall be loosed against you, and you shall not be helped.
verse.verse_36: Which favors of your Lord will you both belie?
verse.verse_37: When the heaven splits asunder and turns crimson, like red leather.
verse.verse_38: Which favors of your Lord will you both belie?
verse.verse_39: On that Day, neither human nor jinn shall be asked about his sin.
verse.verse_40: Which favors of your Lord will you both belie?
verse.verse_41: The sinners shall be known by their mark, they shall be seized by their forelocks and their feet.
verse.verse_42: Which favors of your Lord will you both belie?
verse.verse_43: This is Gehenna (Hell) which the sinners belied,
verse.verse_44: they shall go round between it, and between a hot, boiling water.
verse.verse_45: Which favors of your Lord will you both belie?
verse.verse_46: And for he who fears the standing (before) his Lord there are two Gardens.
verse.verse_47: Which favors of your Lord will you both belie?
verse.verse_49: Which favors of your Lord will you both belie?
verse.verse_51: Which favors of your Lord will you both belie?
verse.verse_52: Therein are two kinds of every fruit.
verse.verse_53: Which favors of your Lord will you both belie?
verse.verse_54: (They shall) recline on couches lined with brocade, and the fruits of the Gardens will be near at hand.
verse.verse_55: Which favors of your Lord will you both belie?
verse.verse_56: Therein are maidens who restrain their glances, whom neither human nor jinn have touched before.
verse.verse_57: Which favors of your Lord will you both belie?
verse.verse_58: As (lovely as) rubies and as (beautiful as) coral.
verse.verse_59: Which favors of your Lord will you both belie?
verse.verse_60: Shall the recompense of goodness be anything other than goodness?
verse.verse_61: Which favors of your Lord will you both belie?
verse.verse_62: And beside these there shall be two Gardens.
verse.verse_63: Which favors of your Lord will you both belie?
verse.verse_65: Which favors of your Lord will you both belie?
verse.verse_66: Therein are two gushing fountains of water.
verse.verse_67: Which favors of your Lord will you both belie?
verse.verse_68: In them are fruits, palm trees and pomegranates.
verse.verse_69: Which favors of your Lord will you both belie?
verse.verse_70: In them shall be good and pleasing.
verse.verse_71: Which favors of your Lord will you both belie?
verse.verse_72: Maidens (of Paradise, Houris) in cloistered cool pavilions.
verse.verse_73: Which favors of your Lord will you both belie?
verse.verse_74: Neither human nor jinn will have touched them before.
verse.verse_75: Which favors of your Lord will you both belie?
verse.verse_76: Reclining on green cushions and fine carpets.
verse.verse_77: Which favors of your Lord will you both belie?
verse.verse_78: Blessed be the Name of your Lord, Majestic, Splendid.
